The '''1983–84 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 48th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The season began on 4 September 1983 and ended on 6 May 1984. [[Panathinaikos F.C.|Panathinaikos]] won their 13th Greek title and their first one in seven years.

The point system was: ''Win: 2 points'' - ''Draw: 1 point''.
